page.layout: One page of text, with a decorative headline and title block at the top and a woodcut-style initial at the start of the first poem. No margin notes, no footnotes. Running text in verse lines, set in roman and italic, with a printed page number top right.

main_text.head: IN MVNDI INCONSTANTIAM ET VANITATEM Epigrammata. Ex Gallicis A.Zamarielis.
main_text.p:
ERVENTE torrens fugerit impetu
Flumen, pererrant ocyus æthera
Magnum fagitta, quin fagitta
Præcipiti superantur Austro:
2. Tu me feras tesmoi, ô incostate Frace, &c.

p.i: Mox quæ petebat nunc procul abiicit,

page.notes: Verse lines are set in italic type with long s printed as s in places; transcribed as plain s per instruction. Line-ends where "fagitta" and "Austro" appear are as printed. The "Ex Gallicis" line and "A.Zamarielis" are part of the title block. Reading at line ends in poem 2 ("Vtróque", "reliƨo", "Posciṫque") is uncertain; [?] not added because the forms appear as printed, but "reliƨo" should be checked against "reliquo" in the scan. Printed page number 141 at top right. The final stroke after "occupatur." is a printed mark, not text.
